study.title: The study
study.lead: The entrance to the app. Each thing on the desk is a door to a screen
study.body: You land here after signing in. The jar on the left (JAR) holds the questions you planted and the letters that come back from what you pickled. The notebook in the middle (ENTRIES) is this month's entries. The board at the back (BOARD) holds snippets and photos cut out of entries. The shelf on the right (ARCHIVE) keeps past months' notebooks. Pick up the pencil (NEW) to start a new entry. Touch a thing and its name appears; press it to go there.

concept.title: What Oryzae is
concept.lead: Plant a question, write, pickle it in the jar, wait for a letter
concept.body: Plant one question that's on your mind and water it with daily entries. Pickle what you write in the jar; given time it ferments, and L.A.B. — having reread your words — sends you a letter. Unlike a plain diary, writing here has something that comes back. This room, the study, is the entrance, and the things on the desk are where you go.

question.title: Plant a question
question.lead: Shape what you think about most into one short question
question.body: "Why…", "How might I…" — a sentence whose answer you don't have yet is plenty. Questions live in the jar and can be rewritten any time. Entries gather under a question and become the material for fermentation.

write.title: Write (NEW)
write.lead: Open the notebook and just write. Saving is automatic
write.body: Press this month's notebook (or the pencil) in the study and a single sheet opens. Put down whatever's on your mind. There is no save button — everything is kept as you type. Choose vertical or horizontal writing, or bring text in from a photo.

pickle.title: Pickle in the jar
pickle.lead: Put what you wrote into the jar and fermentation begins
pickle.body: When an entry is done, press "Pickle". Pickled entries gather in the jar under their question and ferment over time. When fermentation finishes, a letter arrives. Until you pickle, an entry only sits in the notebook.

jar.title: Jar (JAR)
jar.lead: Pickled entries gather by question and ferment
jar.body: The jar on the left of the study. The bubbles show how far fermentation has come. When they settle, a letter has arrived. Touch the jar and it says "You have an unread letter" (on a phone, the jar's tag reads "Letter"). Press it to go inside and read each question's result — letter, words and fragments. Add and tidy questions here too.

notebook.title: Notebook (ENTRIES)
notebook.lead: Thicker the more you write. The top one is this month
notebook.body: The stack on the desk is your notebooks. One per month, thicker with every entry. Press the top (current) one to write; press an older one to open that month's list. Old months move to the shelf at the back.

board.title: Board (BOARD)
board.lead: Pin snippets and photos, one board per day
board.body: The board on the wall. Pin snippets cut out of entries and photos you bring in. Cards move freely, and each day has its own board. The board in the study mirrors what you pinned, in the same places.

archive.title: Archive (ARCHIVE)
archive.lead: Older months' notebooks line the shelf at the back
archive.body: Only a few notebooks fit on the desk; older months move to the shelf. Press a spine to open that month's list of entries. Start here when you want to reread what you wrote last year.

letter.title: Letter, words, fragments
letter.lead: Three things remain in the jar after fermentation
letter.body: When fermentation finishes, a letter from L.A.B. arrives — what it found rereading your entries: recurring themes and turns in your question. Alongside the letter, the words that kept appearing and chosen fragments remain, and you can pull them into the page from the panel on the right while writing.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.lead: Select a sentence, cut it out, pin it to the board
snippet.body: Select a sentence while writing to cut it out as a snippet. Snippets are pinned to the board, where you can lay them out and look over them later. Photos go on the board the same way.

photo.title: Photos
photo.lead: Pin an image on the board, next to your words
photo.body: Add a photo with "Paste image" in the board toolbox, or drag and drop it onto the board. Like snippets, it can be moved and rotated, and it shows up in the same place on the board in your study.

list.title: Entry list
list.lead: Filter what you wrote by month and question, search the text
list.body: Press an older notebook or a spine on the shelf to open that month's list. Move between months with the chips, filter by question, and search the text. Press a row to open that entry.

questions.title: How questions changed
questions.lead: Trace when and how a question shifted
questions.body: Questions get rewritten, and after each fermentation L.A.B. may propose a new shape. This screen lays those changes out in order. Open it from the top right of the jar screen.

account.title: Account
account.lead: Language and theme, email and password, how much you wrote
account.body: Open it from the avatar at the bottom left of the study. Display language (Japanese, English, Chinese, Korean) and light/dark theme, email and password changes, and statistics of what you've written.

support.title: FAQ and contact
support.lead: Anything not here is on the public help page
support.body: A fuller guide, frequently asked questions and the contact form are gathered on one page of the public site. It opens in a new tab.

help.title: Using this help
help.lead: Point at something and the card changes. Type what you want to do
help.body: While this panel is open, point at anything on the screen and the card at the top explains it. Type what you want to do in the box above to find the closest topic. Open or close the panel any time with the ? at the top right or the ? key. You can hide the ? altogether in Account settings.
